packageRules.description: Update the four tmux plugin submodules (branch-head tracking) in a single grouped PR. Deliberately do not pin tags as for test/bats-core: these upstream projects rarely create tags (for example, tmux-continuum has had no new tag since 2015 despite subsequent commits), so tag tracking would freeze the dependencies at years-old revisions instead of surfacing updates. test/bats-core is intentionally excluded: its .gitmodules branch=<tag> setting pins it to release tags from an actively maintained upstream tagging scheme, and it runs separately without grouping.

Pin actions/checkout to a commit digest instead of a mutable tag (supply-chain hardening; matches the pattern already used in ci-images). Renovate keeps the digest current and appends the resolved tag as a comment, e.g. actions/checkout@<sha> # v7.0.1.
